summary: Name pennies, nickels, dimes, and quarters and tell what each one is worth.
Find the value of a set of one kind of coin, up to 50 cents.
Tell time to the minute, find elapsed time (even over an hour) on number lines, and solve time problems.
Relate area to multiplication and addition with tiling and area models; area of combined rectangles moves to grade 4.
Solve money word problems with coins and bills over one dollar, writing $ and cent signs correctly.
Solve measurement word problems with whole numbers and simple fractions; decimals are not included.
Find the area of shapes made of rectangles by splitting them apart and adding the areas.
Use parentheses or brackets in numerical expressions and evaluate them; braces dropped.
Sort quadrilaterals into a hierarchy by properties; a trapezoid has at least one pair of parallel sides.
